public_notes.en: Prices are per person for a minimum of two adults on a 4-day, 3-night itinerary. There is no automatic group discount for three or more travelers. The exact hotel or villa, room type, room count, breakfast, vehicle and availability must be confirmed in writing before payment. Request a new quote after the validity date.
